summary: Play an original interactive story without Wi-Fi.
page_description: Play text adventures offline. Parser runs Z-machine stories you send from your computer, with tap shortcuts for common commands and an original tutorial story.
release_notes: The setup guide explains how to add your own story, and messages no longer ask for an IP address.

steps.text: First Light is bundled and plays offline. To add a story of your own:
Once per reader: with it plugged in over USB, run kobo setup --enable-ssh. Then save it so the commands below find it on Wi-Fi without an address.
Check the story, then send it.
